meta.title: GeoLausanne: halal food in a block-by-block Lausanne
meta.description: Explore a 3D voxel model of Lausanne and its neighbouring towns built from Swiss open data, find halal restaurants, butchers and shops, and help keep the map honest with votes and reviews.

map.label: 3D map of Lausanne with halal food spots
map.help: Drag to move, right-drag or two fingers to rotate and tilt, scroll or pinch to zoom. With the map focused: arrow keys or W A S D move (hold Shift to go faster), plus and minus zoom, Q and E rotate, Page Up and Page Down tilt, N faces north, H returns to the centre, slash opens search. While choosing a location for a new spot, Enter picks the centre of the view. Every spot is also listed in Spots in view.

about.title: About GeoLausanne
about.intro: GeoLausanne is a community map of halal food in Lausanne and the towns around it, drawn as a block-by-block 3D city built from official Swiss geodata.
about.how1: Anyone can browse. Signed-in members add spots, vote and write reviews.
about.how2: Votes measure trust in a listing. A spot with at least {down} downvotes and a score of {score} or less leaves the map automatically; moderators can restore it within {days} days before it is deleted.
about.how3: A halal certificate is a separate claim. Moderators can mark a certificate as checked; votes never change it.
about.world: Terrain, buildings and trees of Lausanne and 15 neighbouring municipalities come from swisstopo's swissALTI3D, swissBUILDINGS3D 3.0 and swissSURFACE3D, roof colours from SWISSIMAGE aerial images, facade colours from the federal building register, and streets, water and land use from OpenStreetMap. An offline pipeline turns them into 1 m blocks and streams them to your browser in four levels of detail.
about.metaDescription: How GeoLausanne works, where its data comes from and under which licences.
about.sourcesIntro: Every block of the city and every street name comes from open data:

about.community: Spots, votes and reviews added on GeoLausanne are published under the Open Database License, like the OpenStreetMap data they build on.
about.privacyNote: No ads and no tracking. See the privacy page for what is stored.
